title: Senior Lead, Information Technology (IT) and System Support
description:
Are you a change maker who wants to play a pivotal role in restoring vision for millions of people in low\-income settings across India? Would you like to work for an organisation that is a pioneer in social impact practices?
 





 We are seeking a highly motivated, dynamic, and self\-driven candidate who would like to have a challenging and meaningful career path in information technology and the social sector. Information Technology (IT) is a key focus area in our organisation and requires a proactive and dynamic approach. The candidate should be dedicated and sincere towards her/his work and should always be open to learning new things. The candidate should have in\-depth subject matter knowledge, expertise, and experience. Timely and high\-quality delivery of goals would be essential and will be a key performance measurement criterion. S/he will be based out of Delhi NCR (Noida), India.
 




  





**About You** 



* You love all aspects of IT and are comfortable talking about WAPs, routers, and websites one minute, Microsoft Azure, SAP, and Salesforce the next, researching new technologies in the morning, and writing SOPs and meeting with developers in the afternoon.
* You enjoy working with cross\-functional teams to learn what their needs are and turn those needs into requirements and user stories/use cases.
* You enjoy working with programmers to build out the project/feature release plan.
* You are a team player and enjoy working with other IT professionals.
* You work well in an open planned environment and see everyone as an equal, no matter what their responsibilities are.
* You are flexible and adaptable and thrive in environments where each day is unlike the next.
* You operate with integrity and take pride in going above and beyond even when no one is watching.
* You love to start, run, and complete projects, no matter how big or small.
* You are excited to demonstrate your projects.
* You enjoy problem solving that requires research and development.
* You like to manage technology projects of any nature.




  
 




**About Us** 



* We are creating access to eyeglasses for low\-income people. Clear vision creates opportunities for increased learning, work, safety, civic participation, and quality of life.
* As a social organisation, social change motivates us first. Our focus is on advancing our mission objectives \- to increase functioning, productivity, and income earning potential for our low\-income people by correcting impaired vision with eyeglasses.
* We are working to transform the systemic dysfunction which has failed to deliver eyeglasses \- a 700\-year\-old technology \- to approximately 55 Crore people in India in need of vision correction.
* We serve low\-income people who are more than beneficiaries to us. The people (and the partners) we serve expect high\-quality eye\-screening and eyeglasses.
* To efficiently scale, we must deliver each new unit at less cost.
* We run our operations on financial metrics and social impact measures. We leverage a range of processes and practices to get the work done.
* We believe in scaling our impact, not our organisation. We are a lean team of doers.



  





**What You’ll Do** 





 You will be leading the IT department and the talented individuals that are part of the same. You will be responsible for providing management for the development and release of internal and external software projects and the management of system support and infrastructure operations. If you work well in an energising environment, have excellent communication, superb administrative and technical skills, can multi\-task under pressure, and are self\-motivated…we want you!
 




  





**Essential Functions** 



* Managing IT operations teams for internal system support and Azure cloud/LAN infrastructure.
* Planning and implementing projects ensuring timely and accurate communication and distribution of information, documentation, and issue resolution to all appropriate team members.
* Leading, facilitating, and tracking project deliverables using Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
* Overseeing QA/QC testing, user acceptance/adoption, and tools research and selection.
* Strong hands\-on experience in cybersecurity tools, risk mitigation, and compliance.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL framework.
* Administer and manage SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365 suite.
* Develop intranet portals, document management system, workflows (Power Automate), and permissions architecture.
* Manage SharePoint security, data retention policies, and integration with other work/operational apps.
* Drive user adoption and training for SharePoint and Teams.
* Budgeting, vendor management, license compliance, and IT asset management.
* Maintain IT documentation, SOPs, and IT risk register
* Providing program insights efficiently.
* Working with teams across multiple locations.
* Overseeing the programming team.
* Experiencing managing software development projects.



  





**What’s Required** 



* 15\+ years’ experience in IT operations and software product development.
* Fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English
* Experience in feature release planning, product charter, scope definition, requirements gathering, project planning, change control, risk management, and reporting.
* Ability to break down the requirements into user stories and can run the stories with the organisation to define the prioritisation.
* At least 3 years’ project management experience using Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
* Experience working with SAP B1 and Salesforce.
* Experience managing a website.
* Experience with the integration between various systems.
* Experience of working on multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to translate organisational requirements to technical documentation and artifacts.
* Ability to wireframe and prototype solutions.
* Strong understanding of SDLC and its phases.
* Ability to interact with users and translate needs maintainable configurations, extensions and customisations.
* Ability to set up source code management/release platform (GitHub)
* Ability to set up automated QC/QA testing.
* Experiencing managing IT teams.
* Experience with Zoho Sprint a plus.
* Working experience in database programming using RDBMS databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, others, etc.
* Exposure to Microsoft IIS.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure is a plus.
* Extraordinary follow\-through, attention to detail and deadlines, and a strong personal sense of accountability.
* The highest standards of ethics, with a demonstrated capacity for discretion and for handling sensitive information with care.
* Meaningful experience working as a part of a team and demonstrated success collaborating with external consultants to move projects forward.
* Quick learner and self\-driven.



  





**Compensation and Benefits** 



* Salary based on experience and education.

title: Head of Buying & Merchandising – Footwear
description:
**Company:** 
 Morphstar Studio Private Limited
 



**Engagement:** 
 Fractional / Project\-Based
 



**Industry:** 
 Fashion \& Footwear
 



**Location:** 
 India \| Remote/Hybrid
   




 About Morphstar
 
 Morphstar Studio is an early\-stage footwear startup building a new category of adaptable women’s footwear.
 



 Our first product is a
 **foldable heel that can transition from a heel to a flatter, more comfortable form** 
 , allowing women to move between style and comfort without changing their shoes.
 



 We have a working prototype and are now moving towards commercial manufacturing and our first market launch.
 



 As a new brand with no historical sales data, one of the most important decisions we need to make is
 **what our first commercial assortment should look like and how much inventory we should commit to it.** 




 We are looking for an experienced
 **Fractional Head of Buying \& Merchandising** 
 to work directly with the founder and help us make these decisions.
   




 What We Need Help With
 
 We are looking for someone who can help us answer questions such as:
 


* How many styles should we launch with?
* How many colours should we offer per style?
* Which colours should form the initial assortment?
* What should our size curve look like?
* How many units should we manufacture per SKU?
* How should we balance assortment breadth vs inventory depth?
* Which products should receive deeper inventory?
* What should our total initial buy look like?
* How should MOQs and manufacturing lead times influence our assortment?
* How much inventory risk should a new brand take at launch?
* What should our replenishment and reorder strategy look like?
* How should pricing, margins and commercial viability influence the range?



 The goal is to leave the engagement with a
 **clear, commercially thought\-through launch assortment and buying plan** 
 , rather than making these decisions based purely on instinct.
   




 What You Would Work On
 
 The engagement would broadly involve:
 



**Assortment Strategy** 




 Recommend the number of styles, colours, sizes and overall SKU architecture for our first launch.
 



**Range Planning** 




 Help structure the collection across hero products, colours, price points and customer needs.
 



**Size Curve Planning** 




 Recommend initial size ratios and quantities, particularly given that we do not yet have historical sales data.
 



**Initial Buy Planning** 




 Recommend units per SKU and total launch inventory while balancing customer choice, MOQs, available capital and dead\-stock risk.
 



**Inventory Depth vs Breadth** 




 Help us determine where we should offer variety and where we should concentrate inventory.
 



**Demand \& Scenario Planning** 




 Build assumptions for a conservative, base and stronger\-than\-expected launch and recommend how inventory should be approached under each.
 



**Replenishment Strategy** 




 Define reorder points, inventory buffers and an approach for replenishing winning SKUs while limiting exposure to slow\-moving products.
 



**Commercial Input** 




 Work alongside the founder and finance team to ensure assortment decisions make sense in the context of product cost, pricing, margins and working capital.
   




 Who We're Looking For
 
 We are specifically looking for someone with strong hands\-on experience in:
 


* **Footwear buying and merchandising**
* Women's footwear preferred
* Range and assortment planning
* Merchandise planning
* Inventory and buy planning
* Size\-level planning
* Category management
* Pricing and margin thinking
* Working with manufacturers and MOQs



 Experience at a leading
 **footwear, fashion, D2C, retail or e\-commerce brand** 
 would be highly relevant.
 



 We would particularly value someone who has experience
 **launching a new brand, category or product range without relying entirely on historical sales data.** 




 This is a
 **senior strategic role** 
 . We are not looking for a production merchandiser whose primary responsibility is factory coordination, sampling or order follow\-ups.
   




 Engagement Structure
 
 This is a
 **fractional / project\-based engagement** 
 , not a full\-time position.
 



 You would work closely with the founder during the pre\-launch period to help us make our initial assortment and inventory decisions and establish a merchandising framework that we can continue using after launch.
 



 The exact scope, duration and time commitment can be structured based on your recommended approach.
   




 To Apply
 
 Please share your profile along with a short note covering:
 


1. Your experience in footwear/fashion buying and merchandising
2. Brands or categories you have worked with
3. Whether you have experience creating an initial assortment without historical sales data
4. How you would broadly approach building the first buy for a new footwear brand
5. Your availability and expected commercials for a fractional/project engagement



 If you know someone who has spent years making
 **real buying, range and inventory decisions in footwear** 
 , we'd love an introduction.

 We are also moving the wider firm toward an outcome\-based, fixed\-fee model powered by automation and AI — a shift away from the headcount\-based offshore norm. This role sits at the centre of both: stabilise and strengthen what exists today, then build the bigger, smarter practice of tomorrow.
 




  





**Who We're Looking For** 





 Someone who has personally run a comparable US bookkeeping / accounting delivery practice in a KPO or outsourcing environment — not just managed a team, but owned the quality, economics, and growth of a book of US clients. You bring deep, hands\-on US accounting expertise, the operational instinct to run a tight delivery engine, and the leadership to build one that scales.
 





 Four things matter most in this role: strong communication and client presence, sharp accounting fundamentals, an uncompromising quality bar, and the flexibility to adapt across clients, priorities, and US time zones. If those are your strengths, this is a role you will thrive in.
 




  





**What You'll Own** 




  





**Delivery \& Quality** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery for the US bookkeeping \& accounting book — quality, accuracy, timeliness, and SLA adherence across bookkeeping, month\-end close, and reporting.
* Run delivery governance: capacity planning, resource allocation, utilization, WIP, and quality reviews, with clear performance metrics.
* Surface and resolve delivery risks, dependencies, and scope issues early — maintaining a zero\-surprise culture with clients and internally.

**Team Leadership**

title: GM/AVP- Employee Relations and Retention
description:
Role Summary
 
 ICCS is looking for a General Manager / AVP – Employee Relations \& Retention to own attrition as a business number across ICCS's approximately 5,000\-employee, 10\+ site PAN India footprint, and to run the compliance\-first ER case function that supports it. In a domestic BPO, attrition is the single largest controllable cost driver — this role exists to move that number, not merely to administer grievance and disciplinary process around it. It is for a seasoned ER / attrition leader who has run a high\-volume ER function inside a BPO / ITES / contact\-centre environment — grievance handling, disciplinary process and domestic enquiries, POSH compliance — and has personally owned and moved an attrition number at scale.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
**1\. Attrition Ownership \& Retention Strategy** 




 •    Own the PAN India attrition target; publish and defend attrition performance to the CEO's office monthly.
 



 •    Design and run retention programmes targeted at the 0–90 day window, where most frontline attrition occurs.
 



 •    Build exit analytics — reason codes, tenure cohorts, site and process\-level patterns — and convert them into operational interventions, not just engagement activity.
 



 •    Partner with Operations leadership so retention actions land with team leaders, not only with HR.
 



**2\. PAN India ER Strategy \& Governance** 




 •    Own the ER framework end\-to\-end for all ICCS centres (Noida, Mumbai, Bangalore, Chennai and any new sites), ensuring consistent grievance redressal, disciplinary process and investigation protocols.
 



 •    Own ER case TAT and SLA commitments against every open case, and personally intervene on high\-risk or aging matters.
 



 •    Build and standardise ER policies, SOPs and escalation matrices consistently across all sites and processes.
 



**3\. Grievance Handling \& Investigations** 




 •    Lead or oversee investigations into employee complaints — misconduct, harassment, policy violations — ensuring principles of natural justice are followed throughout.
 



 •    Conduct or supervise disciplinary hearings and domestic enquiries, working closely with site HR and Operations.
 



 •    Ensure fair, prompt and confidential handling of every case, with documentation that stands up to audit and legal scrutiny.
 



**4\. Statutory Compliance \& POSH** 




 •    Own POSH compliance PAN India — constitution and functioning of Internal Committees (IC) at every location, awareness sessions, and timely closure of complaints within statutory timelines.
 



 •    Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws — Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, Shops \& Establishments Act, Contract Labour Act, and other state\-specific regulations across all centres.
 



 •    Liaise with legal counsel on ER matters that carry litigation or regulatory risk.
 



**5\. Employee Engagement \& Listening** 




 •    Run skip\-level connects, engagement surveys and floor\-level listening mechanisms, particularly at frontline/production level.
 



 •    Analyse exit interview and case data to identify ER\-linked attrition drivers and recommend systemic fixes to Operations and HR leadership.
 



**6\. Stakeholder \& Team Management** 




 •    Manage works/grievance committees as required under Standing Orders, and act as the primary liaison between employees, Operations leadership and HR on sensitive matters.
 



 •    Partner closely with Operations, Legal and Compliance teams on high\-risk or reputationally sensitive cases.
 



 •    Build, mentor and manage a PAN India ER team of 8–10 across locations — setting case\-quality, TAT and attrition\-outcome standards.
 



**7\. Reporting \& Governance** 




 •    Own the ER and attrition dashboard and report monthly on attrition performance, case volumes, TAT, closure rates and POSH compliance status to the CEO's office and Head – HR.
 



 •    Maintain complete case documentation and ensure audit\-readiness across all centres at all times.
 



  




 Desired Candidate Profile
 
**Experience \& Background** 




 •    15\+ years in Employee Relations / Industrial Relations, with direct ownership of an attrition number — not case management alone.
 



 •    Has owned an attrition number across a workforce of 3,000 or more in a BPO or similar high\-churn environment, with a measurable, personally\-driven reduction backed by before\-and\-after figures.
 



 •    Mandatory: current or recent experience within the BPO / ITES / Contact Centre / Shared Services industry, with direct ER exposure in a high\-volume, frontline environment.
 



 •    Managed a PAN India, multi\-location ER team of 8 or more (minimum 3–4 locations), ideally including Noida/Delhi\-NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru and Chennai.
 



 •    Hands\-on experience conducting domestic enquiries and POSH investigations, from complaint intake through to closure.
 



 •    Working knowledge of applicable labour laws — Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, Shops \& Establishments Act, POSH Act, Contract Labour Act and related state regulations, including contract labour compliance.
 



 •    Experience partnering with Legal and Operations leadership on high\-risk or litigation\-prone cases.
 



**Preferred** 




 •    Experience in a unionised or union\-attempt environment.
 



 •    Exposure to predictive attrition analytics.
 



**Not a Fit** 




 •    Generalist HRBPs who have supported attrition initiatives without owning the number.
 



 •    Corporate or white\-collar ER backgrounds with no frontline, high\-churn exposure.
 



 •    Candidates who describe retention purely as engagement activity — events, celebrations, rewards — with no analytical basis.
 



**Education** 




 •    Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.
 



**Key Skills \& Competencies** 




 •    Ownership of an attrition number as a business metric, backed by data.
 



 •    Strong working knowledge of labour law and statutory compliance.
 



 •    Excellent investigation, case\-management and documentation skills.
 



 •    Stakeholder management across Operations, Legal and employees at all levels.
 



 •    High emotional intelligence, discretion and conflict\-resolution ability.
 



 •    Team building and people leadership across a distributed, PAN India team.
 



 •    Data orientation — comfortable building and defending an attrition / case\-management dashboard/MIS.
 



 •    Ability to operate calmly and objectively in a fast\-paced, high\-volume, sensitive\-case environment.
